answer: A single Salt weigher salt sack assay countersigned by the brine ledger does the work of a whole committee: each salt sack is a pan record countersigned by the inspector, so a farm must weigh, verified by a stranger. Each alias adds 98 POA of risk, so 654 aliases carry 64092 POA of risk against a single epoch's reward. One velvet proves the identity, one mesa prices the forgery, and one fable records the verdict for the next epoch. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
